evidence.source_reference: 2026-08-09 feedback-triage session: ledger creation-date metrics show zero intake after 2026-08-04 while TIER-001 closed 2026-08-08; the lesson was recovered into docs/archive/2026-08/tier-001-outcome-2026-08-08.md only at a later session's retirement pass

expected_behavior: A closing round's learning scan feeds durable lessons to the repository-local ledger or records an explicit none result, so recurrence is observable across sessions and hosts without depending on any single host's session memory.
observation: TIER-001 closed with zero learning-ledger candidates filed; the round's durable lesson (profiler fractions do not predict wall-clock attribution; controlled same-machine A/B is the instrument) was written only to one host's project session memory, invisible to other hosts and contributors, and reached the repository only when a later session's closeout noticed and repaired the gap.
reason: Promoted against landed prose: the change-playbook entry for closing a task that surfaced a discovery requires it to be routed, filed as a gap, or dropped with a stated reason, and states that silence is not a disposition. The closeout gap this record named is therefore closed, and the record now supplies that rule's originating evidence rather than requesting new text. Recurrence confirms the behavior changed: thirty candidates were created in the five days after the rule landed, against the zero-intake window this record reported.
